label: Descent stage
blurb: The landing half of a crewed lunar module, left behind when the ascent stage departed.

label: Surface experiment package
blurb: Instrument stations deployed on the ground and left to run for months or years.

label: Deployed instrument
blurb: A single instrument set up by hand or by arm, then abandoned in place.

label: Lander
blurb: Spacecraft that landed and stayed: the largest class of relic in the archive.

label: Rover
blurb: Vehicles that drove across another world and stopped somewhere on it.
